BillHeading.Sponsors: Senators McCune, Fortunato, J. Wilson, Christian, Torres, Holy, Warnick, Dozier, and Wagoner

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to history and heritage education; adding a new section to chapter 28A.320 RCW; and creating a new section.

BillSection.BillSectionHeader: Sec. 1. A new section is added to chapter 28A.320 RCW to read as follows:
BillSection.P: School districts may not censor or restrict instruction in United States or Washington state history or heritage based on religious references in original source documents, writings, speeches, proclamations, or records, including:
(3) The Constitution of the United States;
(5) The preambles and constitutions of other states within the United States;
(10) George Washington's farewell address to the nation;

BillSectionHeader.P: This act may be known and cited as the American heritage act for Washington state.
